why: A confidence that has not moved in four passes should say why it has not moved. The number was right; what was missing was the reason it is not higher.

set.detail: The list uses one spacing value for every row, which reads comfortably at twenty messages and becomes an enormous scroll at two thousand. There is no compact affordance and no grouping by date. Confidence stays at 0.6 across four passes because nobody has opened this screen against a genuinely large mailbox; the reasoning is sound but the evidence is a code read, not an observation.
